title: Fix 301
description: Add clap help text to all eleven list-valued checkpoint flags (--criterion, --requirement, --case, --design, --file, --observation, --bug, --decision, --question, --completed, --blocker), document the full CLI reference in docs/cli.md (checkpoint flags, change ready, doctor --leaks, migrate --json, stage help, top-level chough help), and make chough help --help exit 0 with help text, covered by a test.
no_spec_change_rationale: Docs and help-text only: adds clap help text to the list-valued checkpoint flags and updates docs/cli.md; no canonical spec, requirement, or behavior changes.
acceptance_criteria: docs/cli.md documents the checkpoint command's eleven list-valued flags (--criterion, --requirement, --case, --design, --file, --observation, --bug, --decision, --question, --completed, --blocker), adds change ready to the change row and to the SpecSync change steps section, adds doctor --leaks to the doctor row, adds migrate --json to the migrate row, and adds stage help and the top-level chough help command; chough checkpoint --help prints help text for each of the eleven list-valued flags; chough help --help exits 0 with help text, covered by a test
